'''Davnar II''', or simply '''Davnar''', was a little-known [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Davnar system/Legends|Davnar system]] of the [[Kanchen sector/Legends|Kanchen sector]], located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].

It was the [[Kalidor/Legends|Kalidor]] and [[Unidentified Davnar II species|another native species']] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. The [[Kalidor Crescent/Legends|Kalidor Crescent]] was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] medal of honor, named in honor the creature of this planet.

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The PC [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places the Kanchen Sector and, consequently, Davnar II, in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Additionally, the game refers to the planet as simply "Davnar." The in-game encyclopedia entry for the planet also describes Davnar II as being the homeworld of a bipedal, scaly, long-snouted [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which may be a reference to the Davnarians.
